biotools.summary: SHARC is a molecular dynamics program suite developed by the González group for studying excited-state dynamics, particularly focusing on the behavior of cyclohexenone-BF3 in explicit solvent environments. The software enables investigations of ultrafast dynamics and relaxation processes, as evidenced by recent publications.
